messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's limited rollout -> we saw a sharp p95/regression in search writes between 02:10-02:20 UTC. Need concrete owners for remediation items: auto-rollback, flag default caps, canary gating, and recurrence analysis.

alex: Agree. Let's avoid big scope here  MVPs only. I created an epic and linked the incident. Can we land scaffolding PRs this week?

tasha: I'll take flag defaults. Proposal: new flags default to server-enforced audience_pct=1, with an opt-out annotation. Will add migration to clamp existing flags.

samir: I'll own canary gate logic. Sketch: monitor p50/p95/error-rate over a sliding 5m window vs baseline. Abort if p95 > baseline*1.25 for 5m OR error_rate > baseline*1.15. Will prototype controller hook.

kevin: For the rollback flow I want soft and hard stages: 1) soft: immediately route traffic away from affected variant (no code revert), 2) hard: rollback release if soft doesn't stabilize in 3m. Soft must be automatic; hard rollback requires approvals.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-12-05T02:09:12Z started for release/limited-search-idx

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-91 created (latency spike during limited rollout)

tasha: sample flag config I'll open as a gist and in repo:
```json
{
  "flag": "search-index-v2",
  "default_audience_pct": 1,
  "max_active_users": 1000,
  "enforcement": "server",
  "opt_out_annotation": "allow_wide_release"
}
```

samir: canary gating rules (pseudo):
```
if p95_window >= 5m and p95_now > baseline_p95*1.25 => trigger_soft_rollback()
if error_rate_now > baseline_error*1.15 => trigger_soft_rollback()
if soft_rollback_active and not recovered within 3m => trigger_hard_rollback()
```
alex: Timeline suggestion: MVP auto-soft-rollback + alerts in 2 sprints, hard rollback + RBAC in 4 sprints. Owners: samir (gating), kevin (plumbing), tasha (flag policy).

maria: Tentative deadlines:
- Flag default + migration: tasha -> 2026-12-12
- Soft auto-rollback MVP + tests: kevin + samir -> 2026-12-19
- Hard rollback + approval workflow: kevin -> 2027-01-09
- Recurrence analysis + quarterly checklist: maria -> 2026-12-15

kevin: I'll add a small API: POST /rollouts/{id}/soft_rollback and simulate CLI: `rctl rollout simulate --id tmp --p95-mult 1.3` for tests. Also adding env var KILL_SWITCH=disabled by default and RBAC gating for flip.

samir: I'll add a canary dashboard and pull request: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-controller/pull/1207. It includes metric hooks and alert actions.

tasha: I'll add unit + integration tests to ensure server enforcements. Also will write migration to set default audience_pct where missing.

maria: Good. Action items: update Jira tickets with owners/target dates, add PR links in the epic, and create a short postmortem appendix listing recurrence indicators (same service, similar latency window). Weekly check-in scheduled Fri 11am. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:

alex: tagging @eng-oncall for visibility and handoff notes.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation starts 2026-12-08.

kevin: One more thought  do we want a per-customer blast radius limit? e.g., max_active_users default 1000 and per-customer caps enforced server-side. I can prototype.

maria: Yes add that as a follow-up item. Assign infra + product to spec limits.

samir: I'll include a canary test harness to inject synthetic latency to validate rollback thresholds. Posting RFC link soon.

maria: Thanks all. I'll consolidate into the epic and share the sync invite.
